subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 12, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 12, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We're excited to share with you the latest updates from our community-driven Linux distribution. As we continue to work towards making AcreetionOS the best it can be, we're grateful for your support and contributions.

In the past week, we've seen some great activity in our community. Our community member, cobra3282000, has been working on updating our Calamares configuration files, including fixing a sequence entry that was causing Calamares init failure. They've also added a new package, firefox-fix, which restores window position restore on Linux. Additionally, they've made some changes to our Calamares files and updated the wayland configs.

Meanwhile, our very own Natalie has been busy working on acreetion-surf v2.0.0, making some initial commits to get the project started. We're excited to see where this new project takes us!

We'd also like to take a moment to remember the late Tim Peters, a Python developer who passed away recently. Guido van Rossum, the creator of Python, has shared a heartfelt message on the Python community forum.

In other news, Zellij 0.46 has been released, bringing new features and improvements to the terminal. We're always excited to see our community members contributing to and using open-source projects like Zellij.

As always, we're committed to keeping our community informed about security updates. This week, AlmaLinux, Debian, and Fedora have issued security updates for various packages. We recommend checking the links provided in the recent activity section for more information.

We're proud to be a part of a community that values transparency and security. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our GitLab instance.

A big thank you to all our community members who contribute to AcreetionOS in any way. Your efforts are what make our distribution the best it can be.

As we move forward, we're excited to see what the future holds for AcreetionOS. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift
